description: The alias rule, end to end rather than on paper: a node carrying BOTH tool and tool_name must invoke the tool the CANONICAL key names. The handler echoes the tool it called, so this vector fails if the precedence is ever inverted again — which is the defect that made a node call write_config where its author had written read_config.
notes: The conformance MCP server echoes the tool name it was asked for, so `result` is the tool that was actually invoked and not merely the one the payload reported.
